description: Simulation dataset: decomposed subsystem savings for AI-coordinated residential solar PV, battery storage, HVAC, and smart devices (Charlotte, NC — winter, n=5) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Boris Budagyan. Per-tick simulation output and derived summary table supporting a study that decomposes residential energy savings by AI control layer. Five control conditions are run under five independently seeded repeats for a single calibrated home configuration (Charlotte, NC; winter; pure-physics simulation with no manufacturer-specific behavioural overlays). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
